title: 雙循環地熱發電系統
subcategoryTitle: 海洋能與地熱系統技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Ocean energy and geothermal system technology
summary: 雙循環地熱電廠不讓地熱水直接接觸渦輪機，而是用它加熱一種沸點很低的工作流體，由工作流體的蒸汽推動渦輪機；這樣連一百度以下的溫水都可以發電。阿拉斯加切納溫泉在 2006 年用七十四度的水發電，創下最低溫的紀錄，取代了昂貴的柴油發電。課程定量分析冷源溫度對效率的影響、工質的壓力比與流量、工質泵的耗功，以及取代的柴油量。
summaryEn: A binary geothermal plant keeps geothermal water away from the turbine, using it to heat a working fluid of very low boiling point whose vapour drives the turbine, so even water below a hundred degrees can generate. Chena Hot Springs in Alaska generated from water at 74 degrees in 2006, a record low, displacing costly diesel generation. The course quantifies the effect of sink temperature on efficiency, pressure ratio and flow of the working fluid, feed-pump work and diesel displaced.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 用七十幾度的溫水發電：冷源的重要、工質壓力比、工質流量、泵功與取代的柴油
v30FocusEn: Generating from water at seventy-odd degrees: the cold sink, working-fluid pressure ratio, fluid flow, pump work and diesel displaced

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：雙循環地熱發電系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「冷源溫度與效率上限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「熱源溫度與效率上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" is correct?
options: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。
地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。
熱源的溫度太低，就不可能用來發電。
optionsEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C.
Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate.
A source too low in temperature cannot be used to generate.
quiz.explanation: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「熱源溫度與效率上限」如何決定「雙循環地熱發電系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。熱機效率的卡諾上限由熱源與冷源的絕對溫度決定，因此地熱電廠的熱效率遠低於燃氣或燃煤電廠，閃發式約 10% 至 20%，雙循環約 8% 至 13%。效率雖低，熱源卻不花燃料費且全天候供應，容量因數常超過 90%；真正的成本在鑽井與資源風險。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C. The Carnot ceiling depends on the absolute temperatures of source and sink, so geothermal plants have much lower thermal efficiency than gas or coal plants, about 10–20% for flash and 8–13% for binary. Low efficiency notwithstanding, the heat costs no fuel and is available round the clock, with capacity factors often above 90%; the real cost lies in drilling and resource risk. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：地熱水只有約 74 °C，是當時用於發電的最低溫度
steps.observationEn: Project file: The geothermal water is only about 74 °C, the lowest then used for generation
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「熱源溫度與效率上限」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限
knowledge.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling
knowledge.text: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。熱機效率的卡諾上限由熱源與冷源的絕對溫度決定，因此地熱電廠的熱效率遠低於燃氣或燃煤電廠，閃發式約 10% 至 20%，雙循環約 8% 至 13%。效率雖低，熱源卻不花燃料費且全天候供應，容量因數常超過 90%；真正的成本在鑽井與資源風險。
knowledge.textEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C. The Carnot ceiling depends on the absolute temperatures of source and sink, so geothermal plants have much lower thermal efficiency than gas or coal plants, about 10–20% for flash and 8–13% for binary. Low efficiency notwithstanding, the heat costs no fuel and is available round the clock, with capacity factors often above 90%; the real cost lies in drilling and resource risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 地熱水只有約 74 °C，是當時用於發電的最低溫度
knowledge.textEn: The geothermal water is only about 74 °C, the lowest then used for generation

quiz.question: 依「熱源溫度與效率上限」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling", which value is closest to the carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tres = 74 °C，得 12.7 %（以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tres = 74 °C the result is 12.7 % (carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱源溫度與效率上限」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tres = 74 °C，得 12.7 %（以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Tres 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tres = 74 °C the result is 12.7 % (carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Tres by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Tres 增加 10% 時，結果變為 14.5 %（+14.4%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Tres by 10% changes the result to 14.5 % (+14.4%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 12.7 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Tres 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 12.7 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Tres with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tres = 74 °C，得 12.7 %（以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tres = 74 °C the result is 12.7 % (carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Tres 增加 10% 時，結果變為 14.5 %（+14.4%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Tres by 10% changes the result to 14.5 % (+14.4%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱源溫度與效率上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
地熱只能用來發電，溫度不夠高就沒有用。
以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Geothermal energy is only for electricity and useless if not hot enough.

Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test.
quiz.explanation: 以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱源溫度與效率上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：可行性報告要同時列出熱效率與利用效率，並說明寄生負載（泵、風扇、抽氣）占毛出力的比例。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Feasibility reports should give both thermal and utilisation efficiency and state parasitic load from pumps, fans and gas extraction as a share of gross output.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 可行性報告要同時列出熱效率與利用效率，並說明寄生負載（泵、風扇、抽氣）占毛出力的比例。
knowledge.textEn: Feasibility reports should give both thermal and utilisation efficiency and state parasitic load from pumps, fans and gas extraction as a share of gross output.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC TS 62600 海洋能—波浪、潮流與其他水流能轉換器系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC TS 62600 series: Marine energy – Wave, tidal and other water current converters. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「熱源溫度與效率上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
熱源的溫度太低，就不可能用來發電。
optionsEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A source too low in temperature cannot be used to generate.
quiz.explanation: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱源溫度與效率上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「雙循環地熱發電系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：效率雖低，熱源卻不花燃料費且全天候供應，容量因數常超過 90%；真正的成本在鑽井與資源風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Low efficiency notwithstanding, the heat costs no fuel and is available round the clock, with capacity factors often above 90%; the real cost lies in drilling and resource risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 關於「冷源溫度與效率上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling" is correct?
options: 熱源的溫度太低，就不可能用來發電。
雙循環電廠用的是有機流體，所以不需要地熱水也能發電。
七十四度的水能發電，祕密不在熱的那一頭，而在冷的那一頭。
optionsEn: A source too low in temperature cannot be used to generate.
A binary plant uses an organic fluid, so it can generate without geothermal water.
That water at 74 degrees can generate owes less to the hot end than the cold.
quiz.explanation: 七十四度的水能發電，祕密不在熱的那一頭，而在冷的那一頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: That water at 74 degrees can generate owes less to the hot end than the cold. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷源溫度與效率上限：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「冷源溫度與效率上限」如何決定「雙循環地熱發電系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 七十四度的水能發電，祕密不在熱的那一頭，而在冷的那一頭。熱機的效率取決於熱源與冷源的溫差相對於熱源絕對溫度的比例。在阿拉斯加內陸，冷卻用的溪水全年只有四到七度，冬天的空氣更冷。同樣七十四度的熱源，配上三十度的冷源，卡諾效率只有百分之十三；配上四度的冷源，就提高到百分之二十。低溫熱源的電廠對冷源溫度極為敏感——冷源每降一度，出力的增加比高溫電廠明顯得多。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: That water at 74 degrees can generate owes less to the hot end than the cold. Heat-engine efficiency depends on the difference between source and sink relative to absolute source temperature. In interior Alaska stream water for cooling is four to seven degrees all year and winter air colder. The same 74-degree source with a 30-degree sink has a Carnot efficiency of only thirteen percent; with a 4-degree sink it rises to twenty. Plants on low-temperature sources are acutely sensitive to sink temperature, each degree off the sink adding far more output than at a hot plant. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Project file: The first 200 kW unit started in 2006

quiz.question: 依「冷源溫度與效率上限」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，熱源 74 °C、冷源 4 °C 時的卡諾效率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling", which value is closest to the carnot efficiency between a 74 °C source and a 4 °C sink?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 4 °C、Th = 74 °C，得 20.2 %（熱源 74 °C、冷源 4 °C 時的卡諾效率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 4 °C, Th = 74 °C the result is 20.2 % (carnot efficiency between a 74 °C source and a 4 °C sink). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 冷源溫度與效率上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冷源溫度與效率上限」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 4 °C、Th = 74 °C，得 20.2 %（熱源 74 °C、冷源 4 °C 時的卡諾效率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Tc 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 4 °C, Th = 74 °C the result is 20.2 % (carnot efficiency between a 74 °C source and a 4 °C sink). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Tc by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Tc 增加 10% 時，結果變為 20.0 %（-0.6%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Tc by 10% changes the result to 20.0 % (-0.6%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 20.2 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Tc 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 20.2 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Tc with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 4 °C、Th = 74 °C，得 20.2 %（熱源 74 °C、冷源 4 °C 時的卡諾效率）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 4 °C, Th = 74 °C the result is 20.2 % (carnot efficiency between a 74 °C source and a 4 °C sink).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Tc 增加 10% 時，結果變為 20.0 %（-0.6%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Tc by 10% changes the result to 20.0 % (-0.6%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冷源溫度與效率上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
記錄不同季節的冷卻水溫與機組淨出力，建立出力對冷源溫度的修正曲線。
泵只是輔助設備，對電廠的效率沒有什麼影響。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Cooling-water temperature and net output through the seasons give a curve of output against sink temperature.
Pumps are mere auxiliaries with little effect on plant efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 記錄不同季節的冷卻水溫與機組淨出力，建立出力對冷源溫度的修正曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling-water temperature and net output through the seasons give a curve of output against sink temperature. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 冷源溫度與效率上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冷源溫度與效率上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sink temperature and the efficiency ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄不同季節的冷卻水溫與機組淨出力，建立出力對冷源溫度的修正曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling-water temperature and net output through the seasons give a curve of output against sink temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：低溫電廠的選址要同時評估熱源與冷源，並以全年的冷源溫度分布計算發電量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assess both source and sink in siting a low-temperature plant, computing energy from the yearly distribution of sink temperature.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以冬季的冷源溫度估算全年發電量時，夏季冷卻水升溫所造成的出力下降被忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimating the year's energy at winter sink temperature ignores the drop in output as cooling water warms in summer. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 以冬季的冷源溫度估算全年發電量時，夏季冷卻水升溫所造成的出力下降被忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「雙循環地熱發電系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。

steps.observation: 連結機制：低溫熱源的電廠對冷源溫度極為敏感——冷源每降一度，出力的增加比高溫電廠明顯得多。
